race.comment: AZZACOOL (6) resumes. She showed ability winning twice in her maiden campaign and tackled some stronger races thereafter, not bad in a hot race at Caulfield in April. Finds a nice race to kick off in and can resume a winner. SHARE THE MUSIC (5) has been freshened since claiming his maiden victory on debut, scoring narrowly at Ballarat Synthetic. Can go on with it now. WHERE'S MY SOCK (3) has been solid in two runs back and should be ready to peak now, look for her to roll forward with the peaks to win. ATTAIN (10) doesn't win many but is going okay and in the mix. RAZZO ROSSO (2) drops in grade from a BM66 at Bendigo where he ran quite well and this looks a lot easier.
